notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598207/e9c606d61a09f97ef4ca0d6830dfc33e0acb2112.png[/img]

[i]Hey, folks, it's been quite a while since I updated Trap For Winners and I had some really nostalgic moments with it this week! Thank you for playing and caring :)[/i]

[list]
[*] Fixed not being able to unlock achievement 'Captain on the Bridge'. Decreased required team members for the achievement from 5 to 4.
[*] Fixed not being able to unlock achievement 'Forever War'.
[*] Removed a leftout meta text from the Bulgarian eddition of the book in the Bulgarian language.
[/list]

notes.title: Updated to version 1.2.0
notes.content:
[b]Major UPDATE![/b]

[i]I've tested as much as I could to make sure that the old version won't break but, please, let me know if you encounter any kind of new issues![/i]

[b]Balance Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Reworked Energy balance entirely.

[*] ENERGY within mini-games is now renamed to FUEL.

[*] FUEL is no longer tied to the story layer ENERGY.

[*] Defeat in mini-games no longer results in losing the entire game. Mission remains incomplete but you lose 1 Energy.

[*] Restarting a mission now costs 1 Energy to avoid grinding for the ultimate mission layout.

[*] Enemies now skip one move from the very beginning of the game, rather than from the 2nd player move. 

[*] Added LOOK AHEAD feature. 
To avoid players blindly popping into an enemy while still maintaining some risk, you can now press [Q] or [E] to scan the area which you can't see and plan accordingly.

[*] Improved situations where players might get stuck without making a move due to layout.

[*] Re-balanced Mission #8 to reduce chance of walls surrounding the player.
[/list]

[b]General:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added multi-language support! 

[*] Added Russian language support!

[*] Added Bulgarian language support!
[/list]

[i]Thanks to everyone who has supported me with constructive feedback and ideas.[/i]
